results.prior_art: 3D case KNOWN in substance (Goodwin 2006, rigid unit modes of linearly bridged frameworks; Power 2014). The framework is the same periodic graph as Borcea and Streinu 2021 Section 7 at a different bar length; the counts hold for any 0 < t < 1. The n-dimensional counts are likely routine (priority unresolved); the unit-spring C11/C12 = (n-1)^2 and nu_100 are the strongest remaining candidate (not found in Borcea and Streinu Section 7 or Goodwin's abstract).
results.statement: The contact framework of the truncated n-cubic honeycomb (2n balls per cell, 2n^2-n bars of one length, dots at the pyramid incentres) has, at a generic wavevector, exactly n(n-1)/2 zero modes (the cluster rotations) and n(n-3)/2 self-stresses per cell, its cross-polytope cell is infinitesimally rigid for n >= 3, and with unit springs and full internal relaxation C11 = 4(n-1)^2/(n^2 2^n), C12 = 4/(n^2 2^n), all shear moduli vanish, nu_100 = 1/(n^2-n-1).

results.evidence_label: PROVEN under H1 or H2 (written proof); VERIFIED (finite check) on 20 polytopes plus 4 counterexample controls
results.prior_art: NOT FOUND as a statement; the ingredients (Wythoff construction, classical radius-ratio rule, polar duality) are KNOWN and the proof is elementary.
results.statement: For a convex polytope P (origin inside) whose pyramids over the facets each have an inscribed ball (the dots), if every wall is a mirror of P (H1), or P has an insphere centred at the origin and all dihedral angles are equal (H2), then all dots have equal radius and equal distance D from the origin, adjacent balls touch, and hole/ball = (D-r)/r equals the classical radius-ratio limit of the dot polytope.

results.statement: The maximal hard-sphere packing fraction of the CaB6 structure type at size ratio gamma = rS/rL is (pi/6)(1+6 gamma^3) for gamma <= sqrt2-1 and (pi/6)(sqrt2-1)^3 (6+gamma^-3) for gamma >= sqrt2-1; the global maximum (pi/6)(30 sqrt2 - 41) = 0.746865 is attained at gamma = sqrt2-1, where Ca is held by Ca-Ca contact and Ca-B do not touch; the packing beats fcc exactly for 0.41023 < gamma < 0.41591.
